1.web: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
1.asv: I must needs glory, though it is not expedient; but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

2.web: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows), such a one caught up into the third heaven.
2.asv: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I know not; or whether out of the body, I know not; God knoweth), such a one caught up even to the third heaven.

3.web: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
3.asv: And I know such a man (whether in the body, or apart from the body, I know not; God knoweth),

4.web: how he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
4.asv: how that he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

5.web: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
5.asv: On behalf of such a one will I glory: but on mine own behalf I will not glory, save in my weaknesses.

6.web: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me, or hears from me.
6.asv: For if I should desire to glory, I shall not be foolish; for I shall speak the truth: but I forbear, lest any man should account of me above that which he seeth me to be, or heareth from me.

7.web: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
7.asv: And by reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted overmuch, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, that I should not be exalted overmuch.

8.web: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
8.asv: Concerning this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

9.web: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
9.asv: And he hath said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

10.web: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
10.asv: Wherefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

11.web: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for in nothing was I inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
11.asv: I am become foolish: ye compelled me; for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing was I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I am nothing.

12.web: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all patience, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
12.asv: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, by signs and wonders and mighty works.

13.web: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong.
13.asv: For what is there wherein ye were made inferior to the rest of the churches, except it be that I myself was not a burden to you? forgive me this wrong.

14.web: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
14.asv: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be a burden to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

15.web: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
15.asv: And I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

16.web: But be it so, I did not myself burden you. But, being crafty, I caught you with deception.
16.asv: But be it so, I did not myself burden you; but, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

17.web: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of them whom I have sent to you?
17.asv: Did I take advantage of you by any one of them whom I have sent unto you?

18.web: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
18.asv: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?

19.web: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
19.asv: Ye think all this time that we are excusing ourselves unto you. In the sight of God speak we in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

20.web: For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire; that by any means there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, riots;
20.asv: For I fear, lest by any means, when I come, I should find you not such as I would, and should myself be found of you such as ye would not; lest by any means there should be strife, jealousy, wraths, factions, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults;

21.web: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness and sexual immorality and lustfulness which they committed.
21.asv: lest again when I come my God should humble me before you, and I should mourn for many of them that have sinned heretofore, and repented not of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they committed.
